{{Quote|You've learned our language.''"<br />"''We have our ways, Danni Quee. You will learn.|Danni Quee and Da'Gara, gesturing to his tizowyrm|<ref name="Vector Prime" />}}
'''Tizowyrms''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of small [[Worm/Legends|worms]] [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineered]] by [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[alchemist]]s that, when inserted into an [[Ear/Legends|ear]], [[Translator/Legends|translated]] and allowed the wearer to speak [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Language/Legends|languages]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], their advance agents used tizowyrms to communicate with the people of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] when completing tasks in preparation for the coming invasion force. Throughout the conflict that followed, the Yuuzhan Vong wore tizowyrms when speaking with the residents of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|The tizowyrm will allow us to comprehend one another.|translated=1|[[Tsalok]], to [[Yuledan]]|<ref name="Invasion 2" />}}
Tizowyrms were small,<ref name="Vector Prime" /> [[Color/Legends|brown]]<ref name="Invasion 2" /> [[Worm/Legends|worms]] [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineered]] by [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[alchemist]]s to act as a [[Translator/Legends|translators]] between [[Yuuzhan Vong (language)|their]] [[Language/Legends|language]] and those used by other societies.<ref name="Vector Prime" /> On one end of their bodies, the tizowyrm had a [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] encircled by sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] and several tendrils.<ref name="Invasion 2" /> Despite their size, tizowyrms were able to store vast quantities of information and transmit to their wearers subliminally.<ref name="Vector Prime" />

They were used by inserting the worm into an [[Ear/Legends|ear]], where it would burrow in and transmit information through vibrations. Once in place, it allowed the wearer to both understand and speak other languages. Tizowyrms could only be used for a limited time, and if left in too long would grow exhausted and vibrate itself to [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Vector Prime" /> When not in use, tizowyrms were kept jars filled with fluid<ref name="Invasion 2" /> or small coffers.<ref name="Vector Prime" />

==Behavior==
{{Quote|Bioengineers? Scientists?''"<br />"''The tizowyrm that translates for me makes no sense from those words. I suspect they are obscene.|Anakin Solo and Vua Rapuung|<ref name="Conquest">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest]]''</ref>}}
Due to war-like culture of the Yuuzhan Vong, some terms translated poorly or not at all, even through the use of a tizowyrm.<ref name="Balance Point">''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]''</ref> Tizowyrms [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic]] word ''peace'' translated to mean "willing and appropriate submission from the submissive to the conquerer" and did not know the word ''forgive''. Tizowyrm translation of the words ''bioengineer'' and ''[[Scientist/Legends|scientist]]'' made little sense to the [[Warrior caste|warrior]] [[Vua Rapuung]], leading him to conclude the words were obscene.<ref name="Conquest" /> ''Amnesty'' and ''mercy'' also did not translate well through a tizowyrm because the idea that allowing one to escape the destiny of [[Death/Legends|death]] was generous ran contrary to Yuuzhan Vong ideals.<ref name="Balance Point" /> The word ''massage'' also was incomprehensible to Yuuzhan Vong when translated by a tizowyrm, becoming something akin to "inflict pain," when in fact it meant the opposite.<ref name="Rebel Stand">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Give me Jacen Solo, alive. So that I may give him to the gods.|Tsavong Lah, using a tizowyrm to address the New Republic|<ref name="Balance Point" />}}
Advance agents of the Yuuzhan Vong invasion force, such as [[Yomin Carr]] of the [[Praetorite Vong]], used Tizowyrms to communicate with the native species while they carried out their tasks to lay the groundwork for their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Vector Prime" /> Once the Yuuzhan Vong forces reached the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], [[Warmaster]] [[Tsavong Lah]] used a tizowyrm to communicate a message demanding the surrender of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. In the [[Battle of Duro (Yuuzhan Vong War)|battle]] that ensued, Lah suffered a defeat at the hands of the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]]. Following the battle, he used a tizowyrm to express an ultimatum to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], swearing to suspend hostilities if they gave up their "''[[Jeedai]]''" to the invaders and delivered Solo to him alive.<ref name="Balance Point" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tizowyrms first appeared in the [[1999]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]'', written by [[R. A. Salvatore]].<ref name="Vector Prime" />
